task.title: Configuring LDAP for Red Hat Quay
task.shortdesc: To configure LDAP authentication for Red Hat Quay, you can update your config.yaml file with the required LDAP fields and restart the registry.

step.cmd: Update your config.yaml file directly to include the following relevant information:

info.codeblock: # ... AUTHENTICATION_TYPE: LDAP # ... LDAP_ADMIN_DN: uid=<name>,ou=Users,o=<organization_id>,dc=<example_domain_component>,dc=com LDAP_ADMIN_PASSWD: ABC123 LDAP_ALLOW_INSECURE_FALLBACK: false LDAP_BASE_DN: - dc=example - dc=com LDAP_EMAIL_ATTR: mail LDAP_UID_ATTR: uid LDAP_URI: ldap://<example_url>.com LDAP_USER_FILTER: (memberof=cn=developers,ou=Users,dc=<domain_name>,dc=com) LDAP_USER_RDN: - ou=people LDAP_SECONDARY_USER_RDNS: - ou=<example_organization_unit_one> - ou=<example_organization_unit_two> - ou=<example_organization_unit_three> - ou=<example_organization_unit_four> FEATURE_LDAP_CACHING: true LDAP_CACHE_TTL: 10 # ...

dlentry.dd: Specifies the authentication type. This field is required and must be set to LDAP.
Specifies the admin DN for LDAP authentication. This field is required.
Specifies the admin password for LDAP authentication. This field is required.
Specifies whether to allow SSL/TLS insecure fallback for LDAP authentication. This field is required.
Specifies the base DN for LDAP authentication. This field is required.
Specifies the email attribute for LDAP authentication. This field is required.
Specifies the UID attribute for LDAP authentication. This field is required.
Specifies the LDAP URI. This field is required.
Specifies the user filter for LDAP authentication. This field is required.
Specifies the user RDN for LDAP authentication. This field is required.
Optional. Specifies secondary user relative DNs when user objects are located in multiple organizational units.
Optional. Specifies whether to enable in-memory caching for LDAP permission check results (superuser, restricted user). Caching reduces LDAP server load. Defaults to false.
Specifies the time-to-live, in seconds, for cached LDAP permission results. Defaults to 60.

step.cmd: After you have added all required LDAP fields, save the changes and restart your Red Hat Quay deployment.
